description.zh: 分销交易号，可能包含多笔主单
description.en: Distribution trade ID, which may include multiple primary orders

descriptions.zh: 分销域给上游通知成功走退款，分销域未通知交易成功前走取消
descriptions.en: The distribution domain notifies the upstream of a successful refund. Cancellation is performed before the distribution domain notifies the transaction as successful.
